query: UPDATE central.tool_call_attempts SET version = $7, invocation_id = $8, invocation_generation = CASE WHEN $8::uuid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $9::bigint END, state = $10, outcome = COALESCE($11::jsonb, outcome), context = COALESCE($12::jsonb, context), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND task_id = $2 AND run_id = $3 AND step_attempt_id = $4 AND tool_call_id = $5 AND id = $6 AND version = $13
